description: Shared definitions for the ActivityPods profile wall feature. Wall posts are notes written on another actor's profile wall, federated via the ActivityStreams 2.0 `target` property on the enclosing Create activity (following Friendica's AP wall implementation). On the ATProto side they are stored as `org.activitypods.wall.post` records.

wallTargetRef.description: Reference to the actor whose profile wall a post is written on.

did.description: ATProto DID of the wall owner.

webId.description: ActivityPods / ActivityPub WebID URI of the wall owner. Present when the post originates from or is bridged to ActivityPub.

activityPubUri.description: ActivityPub actor URI (may differ from webId in some AP implementations).

bridgeSource.description: Provenance metadata recorded when a wall post is bridged from ActivityPub. Omitted for posts that originate natively on ATProto.

protocol.description: Source protocol of the original post.

objectUri.description: ActivityPub object URI of the original Note.

activityUri.description: ActivityPub Create activity URI that carried the `target` property.

wallPostView.description: A rendered view of a wall post, suitable for display in a profile wall feed.

uri.description: AT URI of the wall post record.

cid.description: CID of the wall post record.

author.description: The actor who wrote on the wall.

wallTarget.description: The actor whose wall the post was written on.

bridgeSource.description: Present if the post was bridged from ActivityPub.

indexedAt.description: When the record was indexed by the AppView.
